name: Shootable door switch (target)
description: A switch the player shoots to open a door: on its first frame it locks the door with its door id; shot (its hit points gone) it plays a jingle, unlocks the door and sets its game flag; on a reload with the flag already set it opens the door at once. No trigger needed. Use a pack flag (103-127; 301-351 second choice; 0 = not saved). Decomp MSR mod #6 'Game flags a mod pack can use, and a switch that opens a door'.

fields.name: doorId
fields.description: the door it locks and opens (the door's doorId)

fields.name: gameFlag
fields.description: game flag set when it is shot (0 = not saved); packs use 103-127, else 301-351
